title: Training instructor's account of 'ghosts' using the Nellis weather station restroom
place_text: Old weather station, base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada

tellings.quote: ghosts, you and I would say a group of five tall white aliens had come in off the runway off the the tarmac

plain: Around 1964 and 1965, at the old weather station at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, "ghosts" are said to have come in off the runway to use the restroom, which Charles Hall says were really a group of five tall white aliens. Hall, who says he spent years with such beings there and wrote about it in his book Millennial Hospitality, relays it from an unnamed airman who trained him on the job. If true, it would mean aliens walked through an Air Force building.
